title: Stolen Time
summary: Outspoken and ardent, 36-year-old Melissa Miller, a personal injury lawyer representing some of Canada’s most vulnerable citizens, has been fighting the for-profit nursing home industry for several years. As she embarks on her most daring case to date – a class action suit against three of the largest for-profit care companies in Quebec and Canada – Melissa identifies with “David” battling a powerful “Goliath” of corruption, scandal and neglect.
